# Lexington Gays
> Lexington's weekly LGBTQ+ event guide and community directory.

## Key pages
- /: This week's curated LGBTQ+ events with day-by-day schedule
- /blog/: Long-form guides to gay Lexington, venues, neighborhoods, travel
- /directory.html: Searchable directory of LGBTQ+ owned and friendly businesses

## About
Lexington Gays is a volunteer-run community resource. We publish a curated weekly
LGBTQ+ event guide for Lexington, KY along with travel and lifestyle
coverage of queer life in Lexington. No commercial intent. Coverage area is the
Lexington metro.
